title: Enterprise HQ and WAN Topology (Figure 4-7)
display_name: Enterprise HQ and WAN (Figure 4-7)
desc: Complete enterprise multi-tier campus and dual-homed WAN architecture. Features Access Layer VLAN segmentation (VLAN 10 Wired, VLAN 20 Wireless, VLAN 30 AP/Mgmt, VLAN 100 DMZ), Core LACP Eth-Trunk link aggregation, VRRP Gateway Redundancy, OSPF Multi-Area dynamic routing, and Next-Generation USG6000 Firewall security policies.
tasks: 1. Layer 2 Switching: Configure VLAN 10 (Wired), VLAN 20 (Wireless), VLAN 30 (Management/AP), and VLAN 100 (Server/DMZ) on LSW1, LSW2, and LSW3.

guided_walkthrough.title: 1. Layer 2 Switching: Configure VLAN 10 (Wired), VLAN 20 (Wireless), VLAN 30 (Management/AP), and VLAN 100 (Server/DMZ) on LSW1, LSW2, and LSW3.
guided_walkthrough.theory: VLANs segment physical switches into isolated broadcast domains. 802.1Q trunks multiplex tagged frames between switches, while Hybrid ports offer granular per-VLAN tagging and untagged egress control.

guided_walkthrough.title: 2. Core Link Aggregation: Configure Eth-Trunk 1 in Static LACP mode between LSW2 and LSW3 bundling GE0/0/1 and GE0/0/2.
guided_walkthrough.theory: Link Aggregation Control Protocol (LACP) bundles multiple physical Ethernet links into a single logical Eth-Trunk interface to multiply bandwidth and provide millisecond link redundancy.

vlan batch 10 20 30 100
lacp priority 100
interface Eth-Trunk 1

 quit
interface Vlanif 10

 quit
interface Vlanif 20

 quit

  network 10.0.12.0 0.0.0.255
  network 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
  network 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
  quit
 quit
